finding_summary: The complex cyclic two-neighbor Schur mask has only the uniform norming probability pair in odd dimension and a regular polygon of first-harmonic probability pairs in even dimension.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies norming probability pairs, not every norming input matrix. The analytic proof is accompanied by bounded numerical diagnostics, not formal verification. Historical coverage by the Mathias full text was not resolved.
title: A parity transition from unique weights to a regular polygon of Schur-cycle normers
